title: Build a safer balcony food garden
subcategory: Build a safer balcony food garden
summary: Control structural load, wind, drainage, falling objects and emergency access before adding containers.
steps: Obtain the building rules and professional load guidance when the safe capacity is not known.
Estimate the wet weight of containers, soil, stored water, shelving and people; spread loads only as professionally advised.
Secure pots, trellises and tools so wind cannot send them over an edge.
Collect or direct drainage without flooding neighbours, walls, outlets or walking surfaces.
Keep doors, fire routes, drains and maintenance access completely clear.
warnings: Wet growing media and stored water are much heavier than dry containers.
Do not drill, anchor or alter a balcony structure without authorization and competent guidance.
common_mistakes: Scaling up before a small controlled trial.
